serverInfo.name: Caskworth Premium Whisky
serverInfo.description: Premium whisky and spirits retailer based in Los Angeles, California, offering same-day delivery to 33 U.S. states and 7 Canadian provinces. 682 bottles across bourbon, Scotch, Japanese, Irish, rye and Canadian whisky, plus cognac, Armagnac and gift sets.

transport.note: No live MCP transport is hosted. This card is a static capability declaration for the read-only catalogue API and WebMCP browser tools below.

resources.name: product-catalog
resources.description: Full product catalogue — 682 bottles with price, ABV, region and tasting notes

resources.name: blog
resources.description: Educational content on whisky, bourbon, Scotch, cognac and collecting

browser_tools.note: Agents running in a WebMCP-enabled browser can call navigator.modelContext tools exposed on-page to search products, view details, and stage a cart — see /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json.

commerce.ships: 33 U.S. states (same-day) and 7 Canadian provinces (same-day); all other U.S./Canada addresses 1-3 business days

legal.compliance: Adults 21 and older only. An age gate must be accepted before browsing. Agents must not facilitate purchase for anyone who has not confirmed they meet this age requirement.
